style: Square, hand-painted mobile MOBA skill icons. Obsidian metal, emissive amethyst-violet energy, dark purple backdrop, bold action silhouettes, no text, frames or logos.

icons.prompt: Two armored hands holding a long-hilted black greatsword in a diagonal controlled cut; a short violet slash trail.
Two-handed greatsword sweeping horizontally through one wide violet energy crescent.
Both armored hands on an upright greatsword in a frontal parry; a violet barrier catches one incoming strike. No physical shield.
Long pointed black greatsword thrusting forward through a narrow violet spatial rift; straight directional motion streaks.
Heavy greatsword cleaving downward into a violet fan-shaped ground fracture; bright contact point.
